about_the_game:
Portal: Divinity is a free community-made mod for the Valve title Portal 2, episodically released and telling the story of an alternative Aperture branch situated throughout different locations in Asia.

"You are awoken as a maintenance employee, told by a mysterious voice on the phone that you have been deployed in the wing of Aperture known as Eastern-7 to repair the damaged complex. Navigate through lush foliage and harsh tundras to repair various parts of the facility, while learning that there may be more to this facility's downfall than you originally thought."

Main Features

  • Brand new puzzle mechanics innovating on the ideas seen in the original game.

  • Harder puzzles that bring a new challenge for Portal fans. 

  • Steam achievement support.

  • Standalone mod, not requiring Portal 2 installed.

  • Free to play, assuming you've already purchased Portal 2.

  • Fully logical puzzles, with minimal execution difficulty.

  • New custom styles building on the visuals of the original title.

  • An entire new OST included.

  • Episodic releases, letting you play each chapter as it's finished.

The mod is not currently fully complete, as the first release on Steam will only contain chapters 1 and 2, however, we plan on releasing each chapter as an update to the mod whenever they are ready, and just like the first two chapters, the rest of the mod will be completely free!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / Vista / XP
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz P4, Dual Core 2.0 (or higher) or AMD64X2 (or higher)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Video card must be 128 MB or more and with support for Pixel Shader 2.0b (ATI Radeon X800 or higher / NVIDIA GeForce 7600 or higher / Intel HD Graphics 2000 or higher).
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9.0c compatible

short_description: Portal: Divinity is a fan-made mod for the Valve title Portal 2, featuring harder puzzles, new lore, and new locations of Aperture across deserts, tundras, and jungles.
